mathematical_findings.genericity: Independent unit-sphere Gram monomials; no preferred invariant, cut topology or fixed tensor rank. Dimension dependence is exact rational/meromorphic; numerical pole exclusions remain caller obligations.
mathematical_findings.multiplicity: The first remaining labelled endpoint is paired once; choosing a partner type j contributes rest[j] choices. Recursing on remaining counts and aggregating identical Gram monomials preserves labelled Wick multiplicity. Equal-type pair gives unit norm, not an extra dimension factor.
mathematical_findings.vertex_order: Upper-triangular slots are lexicographic. First active edge picks the least incident vertex, so no incoming edge from a smaller vertex remains; scanning a==i removes every incident edge.
mathematical_findings.parity: An odd total degree in any independent direction integrates to zero by reflection. Diagonal Gram powers add two degrees and only change the radial output.
mathematical_findings.resource_scope: Final total-degree<=512 preflight bounds recursion before allocation; early result-map guard improves explicit failure. Retained_entries counts cached graph/average entries, not canonical Q(d) monomials, bytes, parent temporary maps or CAS scratch. The producer must retain separate algebra payload/time caps.

executed_tests.scope: Cartesian Gram expansion plus independent separable sphere-coordinate moments from normalized Gaussian moments; not the reviewed Wick recursion.

gaussian_adapter_read_only.cut_relation: g_ii^p C_n=C_(n-p), zero for p>=n, matches normalized repository cuts; applied before spatial expansion
gaussian_adapter_read_only.virtual_rank1: Only exact mean -A^-1 B is needed; degree>1 explicitly rejected so covariance is not silently omitted
gaussian_adapter_read_only.eta_scaling: U^p V^n has alpha degree hp+(h+1)n; dimension shift h(n+p) cancels this to eta^-n
gaussian_adapter_read_only.limits: Separate Gram-dimension-shift sign proof and exact initial native-region prefix comparison are required; this static review does not replace them.
gaussian_adapter_read_only.live_caches: The producer currently checks report bytes and cache entries; neither alone proves a global owned canonical-algebra byte bound.
